class.name: StudioEventInstance
class.brief_description: An instance of an FMOD Studio event.

method.name: get_description
method.description: Retrieves the event description.

method.name: get_exclusive_cpu_usage
method.description: Retrieves the event CPU usage processing just this unit during the last update in microseconds.

method.name: get_final_parameter_by_id
method.description: Retrieves a parameter value by unique identifier. after applying adjustments due to automation, modulation, seek speed, and parameter velocity to value. This is calculated asynchronously when the Studio system updates.

method.name: get_final_pitch
method.description: Retrieves the pitch multiplier. The final combined value returned in finalpitch combines the pitch set using Studio::EventInstance::setPitch with the result of any automation or modulation. The final combined pitch is calculated asynchronously when the Studio system updates.

method.name: get_final_volume
method.description: Retrieves the volume level. The final combined value returned in finalvolume combines the volume set using the public API with the result of any automation or modulation. The final combined volume is calculated asynchronously when the Studio system updates.

method.name: get_inclusive_cpu_usage
method.description: Retrieves the event CPU time spent processing this unit and all of its input during the last update in microseconds.

method.name: get_listener_mask
method.description: Retrieves the listener mask.

method.name: get_max_distance
method.description: Retrieves the maximum distances for 3D attenuation.

method.name: get_min_distance
method.description: Retrieves the minimum distances for 3D attenuation.

method.name: get_parameter_by_id
method.description: Retrieves a parameter value by unique identifier.

method.name: get_parameter_by_name
method.description: Retrieves a parameter value by name, including the path if needed.

method.name: get_paused
method.description: Retrieves the pause state.

method.name: get_pitch
method.description: Retrieves the pitch multiplier.

method.name: get_playback_state
method.description: Retrieves the playback state.

method.name: get_property
method.description: Retrieves the value of a built-in property.

method.name: get_reverb_level
method.description: Retrieves the core reverb send level.

method.name: get_system
method.description: Retrieves the FMOD Studio System.

method.name: get_timeline_position
method.description: Retrieves the timeline cursor position.

method.name: get_transform
method.description: Retrieves the instance's transform. (Corresponds to get3DAttributes)

method.name: get_velocity
method.description: Retrieves the instance's transform. (Corresponds to get3DAttributes)

method.name: get_volume
method.description: Retrieves the volume level.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Checks that the EventInstance reference is valid.

method.name: is_virtual
method.description: Retrieves the virtualization state.

method.name: key_off
method.description: Allow an event to continue past a sustain point.

method.name: release
method.description: Marks the event instance for release.

method.name: set_3d_attributes
method.description: Sets the 3D attributes.

method.name: set_listener_mask
method.description: Sets the listener mask.

method.name: set_parameter_by_id
method.description: Sets a parameter value by unique identifier.

method.name: set_parameter_by_id_with_label
method.description: Sets a parameter value by unique identifier, looking up the value label.

method.name: set_parameter_by_name
method.description: Sets a parameter value by name, including the path if needed.

method.name: set_parameter_by_name_with_label
method.description: Sets a parameter value by name, including the path if needed, looking up the value label.

method.name: set_paused
method.description: Retrieves the pause state.

method.name: set_pitch
method.description: Retrieves the pitch multiplier.

method.name: set_property
method.description: Retrieves the value of a built-in property.

method.name: set_reverb_level
method.description: Sets the core reverb send level.

method.name: set_transform
method.description: Sets the instance transform. (Corresponds to Set3DAttributes)

method.name: set_velocity
method.description: Sets the instance velocity. (Corresponds to Set3DAttributes)

method.name: set_volume
method.description: Sets the volume level.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts playback.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops playback.
